messages:
maya: Heads-up — noticed a set of tenants with invoice jumps after last week's ingest change. Seems correlated with sampling moving from 100% fidelity -> adaptive sampling.

alex: saw that too. spikes are largely for long-chat sessions where token accounting suddenly went from 'sampled_tokens' -> extrapolated full tokens.

priya: can you paste an example billing event that changed shape?

maya: sure, snippet:```json
{"tenant_id":"t-23","session_id":"s-9","tokens_recorded":1200,"sampling_ratio":0.25,"estimated_tokens":4800,"ingest_fidelity":"adaptive"}```

sam: oh interesting — we used to rewrite those into a single `tokens` value during postproc but adaptive kept both fields and the aggregator treated `estimated_tokens` as additive.

alex: that explains it. aggregator rule: prefer `tokens_recorded` if present, otherwise use `estimated_tokens`. but postproc currently emits both for traceability.

maya: result: invoice double-counting when downstream de-dupe didn't see heuristic that `estimated_tokens` is an extrapolation.

priya: two quick options: (A) change postproc to only emit `tokens` canonical field and drop both embargoes, or (B) make aggregator dedupe logic aware of `ingest_fidelity` and prefer canonical.

sam: (B) feels safer for rollout — less churn for observability teams. We can add a `fidelity` tag and a `source_tokens_type` enum.

alex: agree on safe rollout. We should also add a console metric card that surfaces "estimated invoice impact" when we flip sampling for a tenant. Right now ops can't preview the delta.

maya: proposal for rollout plan: 1) add `ingest_fidelity` tag (values: full|sampled|adaptive) 2) update aggregator to subtract `tokens_recorded` from `estimated_tokens` when both present 3) add console preview + alert on >5% projected invoice delta 4) canary to 5 tenants for one billing cycle.

priya: small telemetry asks: add counters for `events_with_both_token_fields`, `ingest_fidelity_by_tenant`, and histogram `sampling_ratio`. also trace sample of raw vs canonical per tenant.

alex: implementation detail: aggregator SQL change looks like:```sql
SELECT tenant_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN tokens_recorded IS NOT NULL THEN tokens_recorded
           WHEN estimated_tokens IS NOT NULL THEN estimated_tokens
           ELSE 0 END) AS billable_tokens
FROM ingested_events
GROUP BY tenant_id;```

sam: but we need the subtract logic to avoid double counting:```sql
SUM(CASE WHEN tokens_recorded IS NOT NULL THEN tokens_recorded
         WHEN estimated_tokens IS NOT NULL AND tokens_recorded IS NULL THEN estimated_tokens
         WHEN estimated_tokens IS NOT NULL AND tokens_recorded IS NOT NULL THEN tokens_recorded END)```

maya: notes: also watch query cost — adding these histograms increases storage. we should try a 7-day retention for the sampling histogram before deciding longer.

billing-bot: @channel Detected projected invoice delta >10% for tenant t-23 after ingest_fidelity=adaptive was enabled. See /billing/alerts/2981

priya: good catch. action items: Alex -> agg SQL + unit tests; Sam -> add `ingest_fidelity` tag to postproc and doc; Maya -> console preview card mock + alert thresholds; I'll own telemetry metrics and retention proposal.

alex: will push a draft PR for aggregator and add regression test using the t-23 event.

sam: will stage postproc change behind feature flag `ingest_fidelity_v2` and run canary.

maya: can we schedule a quick sync tomorrow 10am to walk expectations for the canary?

priya: yes, booked. please add agenda: rollback criteria, dashboard queries to validate, and cost estimate.

alex: FYI — if we move to canonical `tokens` field later, remember to add migration for historical re-ingestion for any tenants that opt-in.

maya: thanks team — let's keep the console owners looped in once we have the preview UX sketch. :thumbsup:
